Model not yet implemented: WaterGAP2Adapter.execute() requires a WaterGAP2Config. To integrate WaterGAP2:
  1. Build the binary from the C++ sources at Models/Water/WaterGAP2-v2.2d/HydrologyFrankfurt-WaterGAP2-65f306b/source/ via CMake, OR obtain access to the Frankfurt WaterGAP2 web service.
  2. Stage global climate forcing NetCDFs (precipitation, temperature) under forcing_data_path.

  6. Parse gridded NetCDF outputs in parse_outputs.
